verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a robotics framework with a large public documentation set, so shipping an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only conventional human-oriented documentation (raw .rst files on GitHub). Nothing shows an llms.txt, an LLM-optimized docs bundle, or docs written for agents. A community remark that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate well describes model behavior, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.
